svg.title: Synthetic recovery: true out-of-school rates vs posterior estimates
svg.desc: Simulated data. 88.5% of 736 true rates fall inside the 90% posterior interval; mean absolute error 0.71 percentage points. Short demonstration run; convergence thresholds not met.
svg.text: Synthetic recovery check: known true rates vs posterior estimates
736 country × year × age cells · 88.5% of true rates inside the 90% interval (nominal 90%) · mean absolute error 0.71 percentage points
Simulated data, short run (2 chains × 160 draws, 300 warm-up): max R-hat 1.04, min ESS 82, 0 divergences.
Convergence thresholds (R-hat ≤ 1.01, ESS ≥ 400) are not met: this is a pipeline check on simulated data, not a formal or empirical result.
B Relative age 4 over time, by synthetic country
Source: examples/synthetic_demo, simulated data, seed 2022. Rebuild: python examples/synthetic_demo/run_demo.py. Underlying table: estimates.csv.
